newsitem.title: USA: MCA in long-term TV deal with Canal Plus.
newsitem.headline: MCA in long-term TV deal with Canal Plus.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd MCA Inc Monday said it signed a long term agreement with the French television service CANAL Plus covering theatrical products for CANAL Plus pay television movie services, pay-per-view rights to MCA's Universal Pictures theatrical products, and creation of Universal branded channels, designed specifically for France.
Financial terms of the 10-year agreement were not disclosed.
The agreement provides carriage of channels, the first of which will be a Universal branded channel on the CANAL Plus direct-to-home platform, CANALSATELLITE.

MCA said the channel will be dedicated to action-adventure/mystery product drawing upon French and European programming as well as Universal's extensive library of titles from this genre, such as "Columbo," "Magnum, P.I.," "Murder, She Wrote" and "The A-Team."
